svg.title: RDB-260 Context, SourceArtifact, AgentText, and ContentSummary Logical Model

g.text: RDB-260 Context, SourceArtifact, AgentText, and ContentSummary Logical Model
Stable and sprint roots locate one Repository;
neither root participates in SourceArtifact identity.
Lifecycle and provenance are immutable facts.
Excluded content, keys, credentials, and resolved SecretNames are never stored.
Refresh records success, failure, or staleness.
Only a complete success can produce a projection version.
Design-only model; no SQL, seeds, scanning, rendering, or allocated identifiers.
Observations, lineage, summary/projection versions, and refresh outcomes append only.
